# The cases of testdata/htmltok (P565): KIND then a space then the text, with \n \t \xHH and \\ for what a line cannot
# hold. html: the tokens; text: HtmlToText; unesc and unesca: the references in text and in an attribute; esc: HtmlEscape.
# scripts/html_oracle.py works the html, text, unesc and esc cases out again with Python's html.parser and html.unescape.
# ---- character references (the HTML Standard 13.2.5.72-80, Go's html.UnescapeString vectors) ----
unesc plain text
unesc &amp &amp
unesc text &gesl; blah
unesc Lambda = &#x3bb; = &#X3Bb
unesc &# &#x &#128;43 &copy = &#169f = &#xa9
unesc Footnote&#x87;
unesc text &test
unesc text &#
unesc &
unesc &;
unesc & x
unesc &amp;&lt;&gt;&quot;&apos;&nbsp;
unesc &amp&lt&gt&quot
unesc I'm &notit; I tell you
unesc I'm &notin; I tell you
unesc &noti &ampx; &amp= &copy2 &aacutex &LT &GT
unesc &AElig;&aelig;&euro;&hellip;&mdash;&ndash;&lsquo;&rsquo;&ldquo;&rdquo;
unesc &nLt; &nGt; &NotEqualTilde; &fjlig;
unesc &CounterClockwiseContourIntegral;
unesc &#65;&#x41;&#X41;&#0065;
unesc &#0; &#x0; &#xD800; &#xDFFF; &#x110000; &#99999999999999;
unesc &#x80;&#x81;&#x82;&#x8D;&#x8F;&#x90;&#x9D;&#x9F;
unesc &#x7F; &#xFDD0; &#xFFFE; &#x10FFFF; &#1;
unesc &#x;
unesc &#xg
unesc &#65x &#x41g;
unesc &unknownname; &not&not;
unesc &amp;amp; &amp;#65;
unesc &#x10000;&#x1F600;
unesc &#x10FFFF;&#xFFFF;
unesca plain text
unesca &amp;&lt;
unesca b&amp=c
unesca &copy=x
unesca ?x=1&copy;2&copy2&notit;
unesca &notit;
unesca &not
unesca &not=
unesca &#65=&#x41a
unesca &amp&lt
unesca &AElig &AElig; x&AElig=y &AElig2
esc plain text
esc <a href="x">&'</a>
esc  < > & " '
